The '''Imperial Bureau of Shipyards and Construction''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] organization responsible for shipbuilding and construction. They once fought a legal battle with [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] over the weapons loadout of the [[E-9 Explorer-class armed long range scout vessel|E-9 Explorer]]. The case was resolved when Loronar promised to only sell it as an armored [[Transport/Legends|transport]].<ref name="Message to Spacers 4" />
